hcm3_offline_attestation.hash_verification: collector final full-file rehash; worker manifest/receipt cross-check
hcm3_offline_attestation.qualification: Offline replay of saved HCM3 per-file completion attestation only. Historical monolithic archive failed; no historical or new lifecycle action performed.

controls: remote/local per-file hashes and atomic publication with disk flush
full final manifest plus native/throughput/source-plan gates before success
separate computation and retrieval progress clocks
no monolithic Huginn tail archive or competing salvage archive
original compute and hard resource deadlines unchanged
exact resource ownership and verified termination; result survives delete race
failed transfer fragments and bounded diagnostic logs preserved
limits: New integration has local fault tests and saved-evidence replay; it has not launched a new RunPod instance.
Hard resource deadline still wins if retrieval cannot finish. Report incomplete recovery; no automatic rental retry.
Separate-disk backup is a snapshot on the same host, not offsite or continuous.
